description: The portfolio's Renovate configuration lives in sborka and is extended by name. What was here before was `config:recommended` and nothing else, and #157 and #158 are what that costs: one sborka release, 0.2.0.30, as two pull requests. The version is named in settings.gradle.kts and again in the catalog, and only a grouping rule makes them one change.

Automerge is a separate preset (`github>youndie/sborka:automerge-harness`) and is not extended here: nothing merges itself in this repository today. Its precondition holds — check.yml runs on `pull_request` — so it can be added as its own change, and this is the repository where that is worth thinking about: publish.yml runs on push to main, so what merges here reaches a release path quickly.

customManagers.description: Versions that live in the harness scripts rather than in a manifest Renovate knows: a `# renovate: datasource=… depName=…` comment directly above a `readonly NAME_VERSION=…` line. DuckDB is the first, in ci/consumers.sh — installed by pip inside a container, it was unpinned until 2.0.0 changed its multipart uploader and turned `consumers` red on every pull request with no change to point at.
